49.7857,-95.1968.ins: Our parents, Cathy & Jim Mitchell, bought our West Hawk cottage in 1960. We are grateful to them for all our summer gatherings at 'the lake'. Walks to Lost Lake - an annual tradition. Enjoy the view. -Susan, Sheila, Barbara, Carla, and our families.
